detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The war is over. The armory is a complete disaster. 

Go solo or team up with friends in co-op multiplayer to sort over 3,000 items, restore order, and unlock abilities to get the job done faster.

Restore Order

Every weapon, box of ammunition, and piece of equipment has its own designated spot. Find the right racks, organize the chaos, and turn the messy armory into a perfectly sorted arsenal.

Solo or Co-op

Tackle the mess alone or invite your friends. Divide the work, organize different sections, and get the job done together.

Over 3,000 Items

Sort rifles, pistols, shotguns, SMGs, sniper rifles, launchers, ammunition, grenades, explosives, and all kinds of military equipment.

Shooting Range

Take special weapons to the shooting range, test their unique handling and recoil, and challenge your friends to beat your high score.

The General expects perfection. Make sure everything is in its place.
